svg.title: AI Maestro abstraction-layer architecture
svg.desc: Four boxes: Server, API, Scripts, and Plugins, connected by three double-headed arrows. Server, API and Scripts live in the ai-maestro repo; Scripts is the abstraction layer boundary; Plugins live in the ai-maestro-plugins marketplace repo.

svg.text: AI Maestro installs the Scripts — plugins install the Skills. Scripts insulate plugins from API changes while keeping pace with the API internally.
